name: a-pipeline-marker-is-not-wrapped-in-prose
replace:
graphics.failDayRegen(day, for: event.id,
                                      reason: "\(day.displayName) regeneration failed: \(pipelineError)")
breaks: the day's failure is recorded as a sentence with the pipeline's marker buried inside it, so the Friday card's prefix check cannot match and the one failure with two ways out is shown with neither, on a day that will fail identically on every retry (#730, L199)
